comment: Single source of truth for the 100s 'Norway: The Viking Row' timeline. CLIP-BASED ONLY (CLAUDE.md #11): 14 distinct video clips, every src used exactly once, no loops. Player clips (5s, silent, from content/videos/Norway/) play once, slow-fitted by VideoSprite's autoRate. Crowd/chant clips are Seedance 2.0 generations WITH native audio — the 'RO! RO!' chant sound; mux.mjs mixes each clip's own audio at its slot when vol > 0, which is how the chant lands BETWEEN the players. Music: Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC-BY 4.0 — credit required in the upload description.

music.comment: Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC-BY 4.0. Tense build under the cold open, epic bed under the players, heroic swell for the celebration + CTA. The chant bursts keep the bed low so the crowd's RO! RO! leads.
